maps.title: Skyfall
maps.subtitle: A lunar battlefield across three floating levels.
maps.description: Fight across floating lunar platforms, use wall mounts and cradles, and traverse between levels. Falling onto the lunar surface is fatal.

maps.title: Faceoff
maps.subtitle: Opposing bases on a volcanic battlefield at dusk.
maps.description: Cross burnt basalt terrain and lethal lava fissures, use cargo lifts to reach flag floors, and take validated jump routes between the banks. Team pulse guns defend each base.

maps.title: Ramparts
maps.subtitle: Martian crater lake linked by thruster decks and a rotating junction.
maps.description: Cross six moving floaters and a clockwise rotating junction, raid the cistern bases, and control the side platforms inside a mountain-ringed crater lake. Falling into the lake is fatal.
